channel.title: Times of San Diego - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Times of San Diego (timesofsandiego.com)

item.title: Padres host celebration of life for Cy Young winner Randy Jones
item.description: Padres fans are invited to pay their respects to former Cy Young winner Randy Jones, who pitched for the San Diego Padres for eight years, at a celebration of life ceremony at Petco Park Saturday.

item.title: Costco sued in suit claiming false ‘no preservatives’ advertising in chicken
item.description: Costco sued in suit claiming false 'no preservatives' advertising in chicken.

item.title: Grandfather who died in ICE custody had felt ill for weeks, daughter says
item.description: The man is one of six people to die in Immigration and Customs Enforcement custody in the first few weeks of 2026.

item.title: Opinion: Newsom’s budget promises big revenue gain, but we’ve been down that path before
item.description: If a projected $42.3 billion revenue increase is real, Gavin Newsom can end his governorship with California’s finances no longer plagued by deficits.

item.title: Dozens of flights into and out of San Diego canceled or delayed
item.description: More than 70 flights into and out of San Diego International Airport were canceled or delayed Saturday due to a major winter storm gripping a vast stretch of the United States.

item.title: Mega Millions jackpot surges to $285 Million; Perris ticket wins $1.26 Million
item.description: The Mega Millions jackpot is on the move again after no tickets matched all six numbers in the latest drawing, pushing the estimated jackpot for Tuesday’s drawing to $285 million.

item.title: Man tells jury Pacific Beach killing was self-defense
item.description: A Pacific Beach man told a jury on that he killed a man staying in his condo, but it was because the man "was terrorizing" the occupants.

item.title: Suspect in Mission Beach stabbing found mentally incompetent
item.description: The man accused of stabbing a Mission Beach bartender seven times was committed to a state mental hospital.

item.title: Opposition groups unite as challenge to Balboa Park parking fees gathers momentum
item.description: The speakers at a rally at the park's Organ Pavilion included members of San Diego United Communities and a former suburban mayor.

item.title: Once a crumbling Navy center, 25 years later Arts District Liberty Station is place for arts to flourish
item.description: Over the past two decades, 18 of 26 buildings gifted to the Arts District have been transformed from their former use as Navy training grounds.
